calls.title: Cris to provide input on what head's of experimentation care about
calls.summary: The team discussed the performance of 16 outbound campaigns targeting 5,300 prospects, which have shown limited success due to ineffective messaging. Current outreach focuses on experimentation frameworks, which do not resonate with engineering personas seeking specific feature capabilities. It was highlighted that product leaders respond better to messaging that demonstrates the ROI of features, indicating a need for targeted outreach based on the persona's role. There is an emphasis on organizing messages for experienced versus newer users and leveraging top-down executive buy-in to facilitate adoption. Addressing operational risks and ensuring tailored content for distinct audience segments emerged as critical aspects moving forward.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Outbound Campaigns, Feature Flags, Data Analytics, Engineering Leadership, Messaging Strategy
